findings: Risk register binds purpose and recipient scope and prohibits secondary use without a separate decision.
Crosswalk and decision candidate do not yet name the exact recipient classes or the separate decision token required for any secondary use.
required_corrections: Add an explicit recipient-class enumeration and a separate secondary-use decision reference to the normative profile before CS-G1 freeze.
residual_risks: Secondary use could be inferred from execution evidence if recipient scope remains abstract at freeze time.

findings: Reference-first minimization and field-level purpose are required by the risk register.
No field-level purpose allowlist is present in the frozen candidate artifacts.
required_corrections: Define and bind a field-level purpose and authorization table for every retained prompt, response, or tool field.
residual_risks: Over-collection may occur if field-level justification is deferred until after CS-G1.

findings: Class-based retention, tombstone/revocation, deletion proof, and legal-hold boundary are required controls.
The frozen artifacts do not yet specify retention classes or deletion proof mechanics.
required_corrections: Specify retention classes, tombstone format, deletion proof method, and legal-hold boundary before freeze.
residual_risks: Immutable history may conflict with withdrawal or deletion duties if retention classes remain undefined.

findings: Linkability review, namespace separation, access control, and public-safe extraction are required.
Crosswalk enforces opaque references but does not yet document namespace separation or linkability assessment results.
required_corrections: Document namespace separation rules and linkability assessment results for all pseudonymous references.
residual_risks: Re-identification may be possible if namespace separation is not enforced across evidence packages.
